rules.title: Protect the primary user task
rules.applies_when: A visible surface gains, removes, or reorders content or actions.
rules.evidence: Approved task contract, before/after states, and interaction evidence.
rules.decision_limit: Visual prominence is not automatically evidence of task priority.

rules.title: Reuse an approved interaction before adding a new one
rules.applies_when: The change introduces a component, entry point, or interaction pattern.
rules.evidence: Change ledger, approved references, and related screens.
rules.exceptions: A documented mismatch between existing patterns and the new task.
rules.decision_limit: Reuse is semantic; visual similarity alone is insufficient.

rules.title: Avoid unnecessary duplicate entry points
rules.applies_when: Two entries appear to serve the same user, state, and operation.
rules.evidence: Entry locations, triggered behavior, frequency context, and approved shortcuts.
rules.decision_limit: Do not classify entries as duplicates from icon or label similarity alone.

rules.title: Cover states introduced by the change
rules.scope: Default, loading, empty, error, disabled, and recovery states
rules.applies_when: The feature can enter the corresponding state.
rules.evidence: Spec state list, tests, screenshots, and recovery interaction results.
rules.exceptions: A state proven impossible by the product contract.
rules.decision_limit: Do not require states that the feature cannot reach.

rules.title: Preserve accessibility and localization
rules.applies_when: Text, controls, navigation, or semantics change.
rules.evidence: Accessibility identifiers or labels, supported locales, and rendered evidence.
rules.exceptions: Only a project contract that explicitly excludes the capability.
rules.decision_limit: Do not demand unsupported languages or themes.
